title_en: Free webinar: Well-Being in Four Dimensions — evolutionary consciousness theory and psychotherapy (16 Dec 2026, Dr Kevin Keith)
summary_zh: 澳洲 EISE Education 免費網上研討會，講者 Kevin Keith 博士（輔導員、心理治療師、督導及學者）介紹 Jablonka、Lamb 與 Ginsburg 的意識演化理論，從幸福與不幸的四個演化維度，探討自我、能動性與心理治療的含義。2026 年 12 月 16 日星期三，悉尼時間晚上 6:30–8:00，Zoom 直播，免費參加；錄影另收 A$19，完成可獲 1.5 小時 CPD 證書。
summary_en: Free online webinar from Australia's EISE Education. Dr Kevin Keith (counsellor, psychotherapist, supervisor and academic) presents the evolutionary theory of consciousness of Jablonka, Lamb and Ginsburg, exploring four evolutionary dimensions of well-being and ill-being and what they mean for selfhood, agency and psychotherapy. Wednesday 16 December 2026, 6:30-8:00 pm Sydney time, live on Zoom, free to attend; recording A$19 extra; 1.5-hour CPD certificate on completion.
caution: 直播免費，錄影另收費（A$19）；CPD 證書須出席達 80% 或看錄影並完成評估；香港時間為自行換算，報名前請以頁面所示悉尼時間為準。
